plan: A protective support who stuns enemies and makes his team invincible for a few seconds.
aSurveiller: His R (Cosmic Radiance). After a short delay, his nearby allies become invulnerable: back off and wait for it to end.
contrer: When he casts his R, back off: his allies become invulnerable.
Dodge his E: the beam stuns after a delay.
Attack him first: he is slow and relies on his allies.
faiblesses: His E is easy to see coming.

sorts.P: After a spell, his next attacks are empowered.
sorts.W: Link with an ally who copies his spells.
sorts.E: Beam that stuns after a delay.
